items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday vs SEA; Rapoport adds positive longer-term news (no IR, week-to-week, aiming return ASAP, Mariota starts).
items.why: Dislocated elbow (non-throwing); imaging/specialists consensus week-to-week, no surgery/IR currently.
items.implication: Mariota starts; Daniels rosterable for return ~Week 5-6 potential.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at IND.
items.implication: Elevated targets for Dalton Schultz (team-high share last week without him) and other HOU receivers.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share in prior absence.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but expected lead.
items.implication: Warren leads RB group per coach; checkdown volume likely high given vertical pass struggles.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + breathers to Homer/Heidenreich; 15+ touch upside.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Clarity hoped early on Zay Flowers (ham), DJ Moore (shoulder), AD Mitchell.
items.why: Practice/indications point to play; load management for Bowers.
items.implication: Start if confirmed; Bowers big TE upside return, Evans WR volume, Warren RB lead.
items.opportunity: Bowers routes/targets post-meniscus; Evans hip manageable.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN (off injury report, good to go vs Rams); Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Full Broncos backfield available; committee but both viable.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN for Sunday.
items.implication: Full go; Nabers WR1 upside intact, Etienne in mixed NO backfield.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead the Steelers RBs; coach says he goes out and gets breathers as needed. Projecting Warren in despite Q (shoulder). Vertical game failing for Rodgers so expect checkdown spam. Backups: Homer + rookie Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comment + usage vacuum; prior 14.8 PPG on 15+ touches.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume spike; start with confidence if active.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead RB role (RB14 util through 2 wks), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard every-week RB2 starter with clear lead.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in prior misses: big games including 8-195-2.
items.implication: Adams locked WR1 with spike in opportunity vs DEN.

items.text: ETR projections live for Week 3 main slate; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.implication: Smash RB1 with massive upside; prioritize in DFS/lineups.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.

LOVE Chase Brown @PIT (20+ touches/15% targets both games, RB7 util, PIT soft vs RBs); Chris Olave vs LV (10+ tgts both, 53% air yards, LV worst YPR to WRs); Dalton Schultz @IND (28% share sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.opportunity: Brown touches/targets; Olave air yards; Schultz TE targets.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role weak); Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, JAX stout vs RBs); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (SEA fewest FPs to WRs, low YPR, WAS low total).
items.conflict: Etienne listed IN by ETR but role still limited.
